about: Labelled replies for the chat intake's escalation classifier (lib/classifier.js). Every case is a reply the deterministic rules in answer-resolver.js cannot resolve -- exact matches and the yes/no vocabulary never reach the model, so measuring them here would flatter it. `expect: []` means the correct answer is to abstain, which is a real answer and is scored as one.
provenance: Written by hand against the live questionnaire on 2026-10-07. Synthetic: no real respondent said any of these. They encode the failure modes that matter rather than the distribution of real speech, so the headline number is a floor on difficulty, not an estimate of field accuracy. Replace with transcript-derived cases once the chat intake has run with real people.
